verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is an agent-extension ecosystem with a Skills API, so asking about scoped agent credentials is a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are subagent tool permissions and admin MCP server restrictions. These are adjacent access controls, not credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
